title: docs(cli): say the three code subpaths are ESM

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Lx3to7qftVwKKnKpjVXPLv)_
Part of #26206

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

This is the follow-up #26321 named. `packages/cli/README.md`'s "Public subpath exports" section gains one paragraph saying the three code subpaths (`.`, `./console`, `./hook-body`) are ESM. Load them with `import`. A CommonJS caller reaches them through `import()`, or through `require()` only on a Node that loads ES modules synchronously (22.12 and later).

That is the written declaration for the three attw `CJSResolvesToESM` items #26321 left in place on purpose. Their export maps stay `{ types, default }`: on Node 22.22.0, `require()` of all three loads today through `require(esm)`, and an ESM-only map change would break those callers. No export map, code or build changes. There is one `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/cli`, because the README ships in its tarball.

The card's remaining half, retiring `@objectstack/driver-memory`'s default export, is not touched here. It is Blocked-by #26324, so #26206 stays open for it.
